_comment: LabVIEW ISO map for the Docker Windows-container clean room -- MIRRORED from ni/labview-icon-editor .lv-iso-map.json (the reference example). Maps a version key -> per-OS/arch offline ISO + NIPM package id. 'x86' is 32-bit LabVIEW. The Docker Windows-container lane installs LabVIEW 2026 32-bit from the 2026q1 windows.x86 entry (install-labview.ps1). ISOs are licensed/community artifacts fetched FROM NI at build time on a Windows host; nothing licensed is committed here.
